sn47.11:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto yena Bhagavā tenupa saṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pe || Ekam antam nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn47.11:1.4: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante mahāpuriso hotī ti || ||
sn47.11:1.5: Vimuttacittattā kho haṃ Sāriputta Mahāpuriso ti vadāmi ||
sn47.11:2.2: Idha Sāriputta bhikkhu kāye kāyanupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam ||
sn47.11:2.3: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi || ||
sn47.11:2.6: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.11:2.7: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi || || 5.
sn47.11:2.9: Vimuttacittattā kho haṃ Sariputta Mahāpuriso ti vadāmi ||
